Ava: Quick heads-up — ran a small probe on prod-stage; seeing TTFT jumps on the short /generate route (<=32 tokens). Heatmap uploaded.
Ravi: Can you paste a representative trace and kernel attribution?
Ava: Pasted an anonymized trace below (relative ms):
```
0.0 req-recv
1.6 queue-enter
3.9 batch-assemble
5.1 kvcache-prefetch (hit)
29.8 kernel-init (softbatch handshake)
31.2 decode-kernel(s)
32.7 emit-token
```
Ava: kernel-init ~26ms here, decode ~1.5ms — odd for short sequences.
Kai: That kernel-init is unexpected. Any recent changes to batcher/selector?
perf-bot: Canary rollout: batcher/v3 -> 30% on prod-stage @2640000500 (change: softbatch handshake flag toggled)
Jules: Maybe the handshake now forces sync kernel preloads or extra KV validation. What's kvcache call counts on traces?
Ava: kvcache: prefetch=1, lookup=0, eviction-check=0. Still a hit, so KV not the culprit on surface.
Ravi: Could be fallback to a slow microkernel path — check kernel-selector logs for fallback reasons.
Ava: selector logs show ~12% fallback from 'quant_fused' -> 'fallback_generic' for short requests in the window.
Kai: Fallback_generic triggers synchronous JIT/warmup of many kernels — that would explain the ~20ms init.
Jules: Action items: 1) enable selector_reason tags on sampled short-route traces (1% sampling) 2) emit kernel_init_ms histogram broken down by selector_reason+route 3) add dashboard slice: queue | kernel_init | decode | postproc per-model-version.
Ava: I'll add sampling and the histograms; pushing a tiny probe now and will re-run.
Ravi: If batcher/v3 is root cause, plan: rollback canary + deploy async kernel warmup patch. Prioritize P1 if >5% fallback_generic persists.
Ava: Running another probe — attaching updated heatmap link. fallback_generic bumped to 11% -> kernel_init median 22ms, decode median 3.4ms. Rolling back batcher/v3 now.
perf-bot: Rollback initiated for batcher/v3 @2640012600
Kai: After rollback, schedule focused perf run with selector debug during low traffic window and compare TTFT 95p vs baseline.
Jules: Dashboard alert: fire if per-route TTFT 95p > baseline_by_route + 10ms sustained for 10m. Also add label filter by selector_reason.
Ava: Scheduling debug run 2640014000-2640014300; will include async-preload experiment in a feature branch. Will post PR & quick postmortem if rollback stabilizes.
Ravi: Thanks — keep this thread updated. If we see >5% fallback_generic on short requests, keep rollback and escalate to infra on-call. :thumbsup:
